The '''Jumus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that became a staging point for the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest of the galaxy]]. The Yuuzhan Vong made a massive build-up of fleet forces in this system to disguise their intent of moving [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|closer to the core]] by passing through the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]].

The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jumus]].
